substantiveAssessment.result: The 902-row raw catalog is a conservative inventory, not the exact set discovered by normal runtime traversal.
substantiveAssessment.detail: Runtime discovery handles root origin, project precedence, versions, platform extensions and directory stopping rules. Five extension descriptors contain no module or dependency payload to merge. Catalog row 467, PregenContent, is nested below the USDPregen descriptor at row 468; ordinary traversal stops at the parent descriptor. Both are outside the current conservative reachable set.

substantiveAssessment.result: All 902 nodes, all 1561 plugin-reference occurrences and all 1774 module occurrences were independently considered from permitted raw selected data.
substantiveAssessment.detail: All 32 reference-selector profiles and 310 module-selector profiles were inspected exhaustively with occurrence membership. Presence, ordered arrays, exact spelling and case were retained. For Win64 Editor Development, the conservative reference calculation has 1551 candidate occurrences, seven disabled occurrences and three occurrences excluded by platform allow lists. Starting from 186 roots, the conservative reachable set contains 245 plugins and matches the frozen selected membership in both directions. No disabled plugin or unresolved reference is reachable under that calculation.
substantiveAssessment.limits: This equality is a conditional source calculation, not observed runtime enablement. Four case-mismatched reference names occur under parents outside the reachable set; exact runtime string-lookup behavior was not established from a granted string implementation. Platform runtime hooks, optional compile-time restrictions and actual build configuration can reduce the conservative set.
citations: Selected metadata records 7 and 12, all 245 membership descriptors

substantiveAssessment.result: Selected membership and BuildPlugins are not equivalent to runtime enablement.

The complete target initialization artifact supplies inherited defaults, CLI/configuration application, hook forwarding and finalization. The wrapper checks exact receipt identity and expected override policy, then passes explicit enable/disable arguments.

errorsAndRecoveries: Several oversized tool renderings were truncated. Missing mandatory source portions were reread with explicit physical ranges. Complete record 5 bindings were reread in two exhaustive ordered chunks. No truncated mandatory source output was treated as complete.
An independently authored graph query initially had a PowerShell brace/parser error and produced no source result. The corrected self-contained query completed successfully.

A metadata query emitted a query-generated field:null/present:false placeholder. This was an erroneous query artifact, not source absence or source null. Exact named-field presence queries replaced it.

A later policy query incorrectly assumed selected records contained recordOrdinal and failed its uniqueness guard. The complete policy was reread, and its actual ordered record representation was used.

All reported data reads used ErrorActionPreference Stop. No source EOF or JSON parsing failure remains unresolved. Earlier exposure and partial optional renderings are disclosed rather than treated as nonexistent.
